cart.france_notice_title: In France: marking is done at an approved operator
cart.france_notice_p1: In France, marking a bike and registering it in the national FNUCI register is done exclusively through a state-approved operator, with a certified APIC sticker. It is not a marking you buy online or apply yourself.
cart.france_notice_p2: your reseller handles this at purchase — it is their responsibility, not yours.
cart.france_notice_p3_label: Second-hand or a bike you already own
cart.france_notice_p3: you are perfectly free to have it identified voluntarily. Go to an approved operator — including Velopass, through its APIC accreditation. Contact a Velopass reseller or APIC: they apply the "VP" Frame-ID and register your bike in the FNUCI. The "VP" Frame-ID is a full Velopass: besides the FNUCI, it stays scannable everywhere on the Velopass network, including abroad.
cart.france_notice_p4: the "European" Frame-ID ordered online is not entered in the FNUCI and has no legal identification value in France. For identification recognised in France, go through an approved operator.
